testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceExplicit
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no conflicting rule, so Fixed30 is assigned.

testSuite.name: HighRateSensitivityFixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with no other matching rule assigns Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ARM71TypicalCase
testSuite.description: Horizon at most 7 years, stable income, LTV at most 80, score at least 720, no fixed preference, so ARM7/1 is assigned.

testSuite.name: ARM71BoundaryValues
testSuite.description: All ARM boundary values are inclusive: horizon 7, LTV 80, score 720.

testSuite.name: HorizonJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds the ARM limit and no other rule applies, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 sends the application to manual review.

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so manual review is not triggered and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: DTIExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50, so manual review is not triggered and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: DTIAbove50ConflictsWithARM
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers manual review, but ARM7/1 conditions are also met; the rules do not state which takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 and rule ManualReview (DTI over 50) both match. The rules do not state precedence; with FIRST hit policy and row order, ARM7/1 is chosen. ManualReview is a possible alternative.

testSuite.name: LTVAbove95WithFixedPreferenceConflict
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference matches Fixed30, and LTV above 95 matches ManualReview; precedence is not stated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixed preference) and ManualReview (LTV over 95) both match. Precedence is not stated; with FIRST hit policy and row order, Fixed30 is chosen. ManualReview is a possible alternative.

testSuite.name: LTVExactly95NotManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95, so manual review is not triggered; fixed preference gives Fixed30.

testSuite.name: LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 with no other matching rule sends the application to manual review.

testSuite.name: MissingScoreDtiLtvAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Credit score, DTI and LTV are all missing, so no rule can be evaluated with certainty.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Null creditScore, ltv and dti make the manual-review conditions and the ARM conditions undeterminable. The rules do not state how missing values are handled; [] is assumed.

testSuite.name: LowCreditHighSensitivityConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity gives Fixed30, and low credit score gives ManualReview; precedence is not stated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (high rate sensitivity) and ManualReview (credit score below 640) both match. Precedence is not stated; with FIRST hit policy and row order, Fixed30 is chosen. ManualReview is a possible alternative.

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeBlocksARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM conditions, and no fixed preference or high sensitivity applies, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: CreditScore719BlocksARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so ARM7/1 is not assigned and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: ARMWithMediumSensitivityAndLowLTV
testSuite.description: Stable income, short horizon, low LTV, high score, and medium sensitivity give ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceAndARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference gives Fixed30, and all ARM conditions are met; precedence is not stated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixed preference) and ARM7/1 (all ARM conditions met) both match. Precedence is not stated; with FIRST hit policy and row order, Fixed30 is chosen. ARM7/1 is a possible alternative.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceLongHorizon
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with long horizon, variable income, and mid-range scores. Only R1 applies.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference. Only R1 applies.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryLTV80Score720Horizon5
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met with boundary values: LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720, horizon 5 years, stable income. Only R2 applies.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryHorizon7
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, which is within the 'seven years or less' criterion. Only R2 applies.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMCreditScoreBelow720NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below the ARM threshold of 720; no rule applies and no manual-review trigger is met.

testSuite.name: TC06_ManualReviewCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, which triggers manual review. Only R3 applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReviewDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review. Only R3 applies because horizon and income stability do not meet ARM criteria.

testSuite.name: TC08_ManualReviewLTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review. Only R3 applies.

testSuite.name: TC09_LTVExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so manual review is not triggered and no product rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so manual review is not triggered and no product rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceWithLowCreditAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference (R1) and credit score below 640 (R3) both match. The rules do not state which takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both apply. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output because R1 is listed first, but ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceAndARMAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference (R1) and all ARM criteria (R2) match at the same time.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R2 (horizon <= 7, stable income, LTV <= 80, credit >= 720 -> ARM7/1) both apply. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output because R1 is listed first, but ARM7/1 is possible.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARMAndManualReviewDTIAmbiguous
testSuite.description: ARM criteria (R2) are met but DTI 55 triggers manual review (R3).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1 criteria met) and R3 (DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both apply. The rules do not state precedence; ARM7/1 is the most likely output because R2 is listed before R3, but ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC15_MissingCreditScoreAmbiguous
testSuite.description: Credit score is null, so the ARM credit condition cannot be evaluated and the R3 credit condition is unknown.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null. R2 requires creditScore >= 720 and R3 requires creditScore < 640; neither can be confirmed. The rules do not state how missing values are handled. [] is the most likely output, but ARM7/1 or ManualReview is possible if null is treated differently.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceCashOutRefinance
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference on a cash-out refinance. Only R1 applies because the score and ratios do not trigger other rules.

testSuite.name: TC17_NoPreferenceNoMatchNullFields
testSuite.description: All rule-relevant fields are null, so no rule can be satisfied.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other trigger; Fixed30 applies, ARM conditions fail (horizon 20 > 7).

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 even without explicit fixed preference; long horizon so ARM does not apply.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV 75, credit 730 meets all ARM criteria; no fixed trigger.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryHorizonSevenLtv80Credit720
testSuite.description: All ARM boundaries inclusive: horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit exactly 720.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMHorizonJustAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds ARM limit; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARMCreditJustBelowThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit 719 is below ARM minimum 720 and above manual-review threshold; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC07_ARMLtvJustAboveThreshold
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit of 80 and is not above 95; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC08_ARMVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the stable-income ARM criterion; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReviewCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit 639 is below 640, so the application goes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReviewDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50, triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC13_ManualReviewLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndManualReviewOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while credit 600 triggers manual review; both rules match and the rules do not state which takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference) and rule 3 (ManualReview via creditScore < 640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely Fixed30 because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMAndManualReviewDtiOverlap
testSuite.description: ARM criteria are met but DTI 55 exceeds 50, so manual review also applies.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI > 50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. Most likely ARM7/1 because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC17_FixedAndARMOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and all ARM criteria are met simultaneously.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Most likely Fixed30 because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityAndARMOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 while short horizon, stable income, LTV 70 and credit 800 also satisfy ARM criteria.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via rateSensitivity high) and rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Most likely Fixed30 because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC19_LowRateSensitivityCreditBelowArm
testSuite.description: Low sensitivity, no fixed preference, credit 700 below ARM threshold; no product.

testSuite.name: TC20_MissingCreditScoreNoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; ManualReview condition cannot be evaluated and ARM requires credit >= 720, so no product applies.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled for ARM or ManualReview conditions. Possible outputs: no product (empty) or ManualReview. Most likely no product.

testSuite.name: TC21_AllFieldsMissing
testSuite.description: Only the id is provided; all decision inputs are null.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are null; the rules do not define the outcome for missing values. Possible outputs: no product or ManualReview. Most likely no product.

testSuite.name: TC22_ARMZeroValuesBoundary
testSuite.description: Minimum values: horizon 0, LTV 0, maximum credit 900; all ARM criteria met.

testSuite.name: TC23_ManualReviewCreditZero
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640; manual review applies.

testSuite.name: TC24_ManualReviewLtvAndDtiBothHigh
testSuite.description: LTV 98 and DTI 60 both exceed thresholds; manual review applies.

testSuite.name: TC25_FixedPreferenceFalseNoTrigger
testSuite.description: Fixed preference explicitly false and low sensitivity; with long horizon no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, long horizon, no other rule matches, so Fixed30 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmCriteria
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM 7/1 criteria are met; rules 1 and 2 both match, precedence not stated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Output Fixed30 assumed based on rule order.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit within limits, no fixed preference; ARM7/1 assigned.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryValuesInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, LTV exactly 80, credit exactly 720; all inclusive boundaries met for ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7, so ARM7/1 does not apply and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreJustBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so ARM7/1 does not apply; not below 640, so no manual review.

testSuite.name: TC07_LtvJustAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds 80, so ARM7/1 does not apply; no manual review trigger.

testSuite.name: TC08_UnstableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM7/1 even though other criteria are met; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, so no manual review and no product matches.

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so no manual review is triggered.

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50, so the application goes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, so no manual review is triggered.

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95, so the application goes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceWithLowCreditManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true and credit score is 600; rules 1 and 3 both match, precedence not stated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 3 (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 assumed based on rule order.

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingIncomeStabilityNoArm
testSuite.description: Income stability is null, so the stable-income condition for ARM7/1 is not met; no other rule applies.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how a missing (null) incomeStability is handled; treated as not stable, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScoreHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score is null while rate sensitivity is high; Fixed30 applies, manual review condition on credit score is unclear.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how a missing (null) creditScore is handled in the manual review condition; Fixed30 from Rule 1 assumed, with no manual review.

testSuite.name: TC18_CashOutRefinanceArmEligible
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with all ARM7/1 criteria met; purpose does not affect the rules, so ARM7/1 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC19_NoFieldsProvidedNoProduct
testSuite.description: Only the applicant id is provided; no rule conditions can be evaluated as matching.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how entirely missing attributes are handled; no rule is assumed to match.

testSuite.name: TC20_HighDtiAndLowLtvManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers manual review even though LTV and credit score are acceptable.

flaggedCases.note: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Output Fixed30 assumed based on rule order.

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_only
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule matching (credit below 720) gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: high_rate_sensitivity_fixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity alone assigns Fixed30

testSuite.name: high_sensitivity_and_manual_review_conflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (Fixed30) and credit score below 640 (ManualReview) both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via high rate sensitivity) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via credit score below 640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen by rule order.

testSuite.name: arm_boundary_inclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM7/1 boundaries inclusive: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, stable income

testSuite.name: arm_horizon_just_over_limit

testSuite.name: arm_variable_income_no_match
testSuite.description: Variable income fails the ARM7/1 condition and no other rule matches

testSuite.name: arm_ltv_just_over_limit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80 so ARM7/1 does not apply

testSuite.name: arm_credit_just_below_limit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 so ARM7/1 does not apply

testSuite.name: manual_review_credit_just_below_640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 so ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: credit_exactly_640_no_manual_review
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule matches

testSuite.name: dti_exactly_50_no_manual_review
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no rule matches

testSuite.name: dti_above_50_manual_review
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 is above 50 so ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: ltv_exactly_95_no_manual_review
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no rule matches

testSuite.name: ltv_above_95_manual_review
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 so ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: arm_and_manual_review_overlap_dti
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 conditions met but DTI 55 triggers ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI above 50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 chosen by rule order.

testSuite.name: fixed_and_arm_overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM7/1 conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen by rule order.

testSuite.name: missing_credit_score_for_arm
testSuite.description: Credit score is null so ARM7/1 and ManualReview conditions cannot be verified
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is missing; the rules do not say how a missing value is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview. Empty result chosen.

testSuite.name: all_fields_missing
testSuite.description: Only the id is provided; all decision inputs are null
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are missing; the rules do not define behavior for missing values. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview. Empty result chosen.

testSuite.name: arm_boundary_zero_horizon_max_credit
testSuite.description: Minimum horizon 0, maximum credit score 900, LTV 0 and DTI 0 give ARM7/1

testSuite.name: credit_zero_manual_review
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640 so ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_refinance_full_data
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with full loan, collateral, income and housing data gives Fixed30

testSuite.name: ltv_null_arm_conditions_unknown
testSuite.description: LTV is null while other ARM7/1 conditions are met, so LTV condition cannot be verified
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null and not computed; the rules do not say how a missing LTV is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ARM7/1 if LTV is derived from collateral. Empty result chosen.

newExpected.ambiguityNote: Both the ARM7/1 rule (horizon ≤7, stable income, LTV ≤80, credit ≥720) and the ManualReview rule (DTI >50) match. The rules do not state which takes precedence. ManualReview is the most likely output because it is the conservative gate, but ARM7/1 is possible if the rule order is treated as priority.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, ARM conditions not met (horizon 20 years)

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with fixedPreference false

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_AllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: ARM 7/1 when horizon=7, LTV=80, stable income, credit score=720, no fixed preference, medium sensitivity

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_Typical
testSuite.description: Typical ARM applicant: short horizon, stable income, good credit, low LTV

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year limit; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_LtvJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowARMThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 below 720 ARM threshold and above 640 manual threshold; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScore639_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 so application goes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScore640_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiAbove50_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50 so manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvAbove95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95 so manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference combined with credit score below 640 triggers both Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed preference, outputs Fixed30) and Rule 3 (credit score below 640, outputs ManualReview) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndARMConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and all ARM conditions met at once
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (outputs Fixed30) and Rule 2 (outputs ARM7/1) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMConditionsButDtiAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (outputs ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (DTI above 50, outputs ManualReview) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityAndLowCreditBoth
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with credit score below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rate sensitivity high, outputs Fixed30) and Rule 3 (credit score below 640, outputs ManualReview) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Missing credit score: rule conditions cannot be evaluated for ARM or manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; it is not stated whether the ARM condition (score at least 720) or the manual review condition (score below 640) is met. Possible outputs: none or ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC20_AllAttributesNull
testSuite.description: All decision inputs missing
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Most decision inputs are null; it is not stated what happens when values are missing. Possible outputs: none, or ManualReview if missing values are treated as not qualifying.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullLtvAndDti
testSuite.description: Otherwise ARM-eligible applicant with LTV and DTI left null for DMN computation
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null, so the ARM condition (LTV 80 or less) cannot be verified; it is not stated what happens when a value is missing. Possible outputs: none or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC22_FixedPreferenceFalseLowSensitivity
testSuite.description: No fixed preference and low sensitivity, long horizon, good credit: no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC23_ARMLowerBoundHorizonZero
testSuite.description: Horizon of zero years with other ARM conditions met

testSuite.name: TC24_CreditScoreAtMax
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 with fixed preference and stable income

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, решта умов для ARM не виконується (variable дохід, горизонт 10 років)

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки без явної переваги, горизонт 20 років

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_BoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Граничні значення для ARM: горизонт 5, LTV 80, кредитний бал 720, стабільний дохід

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_HorizonBoundary7
testSuite.description: Горизонт рівно 7 років, LTV 80, бал 720 — умови ARM виконані

testSuite.name: TC05_ARM_LtvJustAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 перевищує поріг ARM, жодне правило не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmFailsVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід блокує ARM, немає інших критеріїв

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640 — ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScore640NoRule
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал рівно 640: не нижче 640, але для ARM бракує 720

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 понад 50 — ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує поріг; ARM-умови виконані

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 понад 95 — ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactly95NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95; жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedAndManualReviewOverlap
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, але кредитний бал 600 нижче 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) і ManualReview (creditScore<640) виконуються одночасно; у правилах не сказано, яке має пріоритет. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndArmOverlap
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, одночасно виконуються умови ARM 7/1
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) і ARM7/1 (горизонт<=7, стабільний дохід, LTV<=80, бал>=720) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ARM7/1. Обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmAndManualReviewOverlapDti
testSuite.description: Умови ARM виконані, але DTI 55 понад 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила ARM7/1 і ManualReview (DTI>50) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: ARM7/1 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedAndManualReviewOverlapLtv
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки і LTV 90 понад 95? Ні; LTV 97 понад 95 при високій чутливості
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (rateSensitivity=high) і ManualReview (LTV>95) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал відсутній (null), решта даних для ARM є, але перевірка балу неможлива
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore=null: умови ARM (бал>=720) і ManualReview (бал<640) не можна перевірити; правила не визначають поведінку при відсутньому значенні. Найімовірніше результат - відсутність призначення.

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingFixedPreferenceAndSensitivity
testSuite.description: Невідома перевага фіксованої ставки та чутливість до ставки, інші умови ARM виконані

testSuite.name: TC19_MissingLtvAndDtiNoRule
testSuite.description: LTV і DTI не передані (null) при відповідних порогових умовах; інші умови ARM виконані
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv=null і dti=null: правила не визначають, чи обчислювати їх у DMN; умова ARM (LTV<=80) і ManualReview (DTI>50, LTV>95) не можна перевірити. Найімовірніше результат - відсутність призначення.

testSuite.name: TC20_NoConditionsMet
testSuite.description: Середній профіль без виконання жодного правила

flaggedCases.note: Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) і ManualReview (creditScore<640) виконуються одночасно; у правилах не сказано, яке має пріоритет. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.
Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) і ARM7/1 (горизонт<=7, стабільний дохід, LTV<=80, бал>=720) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ARM7/1. Обрано Fixed30.
Правила ARM7/1 і ManualReview (DTI>50) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: ARM7/1 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.
Правила Fixed30 (rateSensitivity=high) і ManualReview (LTV>95) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі результати: Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано ManualReview.
creditScore=null: умови ARM (бал>=720) і ManualReview (бал<640) не можна перевірити; правила не визначають поведінку при відсутньому значенні. Найімовірніше результат - відсутність призначення.
ltv=null і dti=null: правила не визначають, чи обчислювати їх у DMN; умова ARM (LTV<=80) і ManualReview (DTI>50, LTV>95) не можна перевірити. Найімовірніше результат - відсутність призначення.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryValues

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeNoRule

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreJustBelow720NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM rule and is not below 640, so no product

testSuite.name: TC09_LowCreditScoreManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScore640NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no other rule applies so no product

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 is above 50, so manual review applies

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIExactly50NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no other rule applies so no product

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95, so manual review applies

testSuite.name: TC14_LTVExactly95NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no other rule applies so no product

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference rule and manual review rule both match (low credit score)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 'Fixed30' (fixedPreference=true) and 'ManualReview' (creditScore<640) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely ManualReview is expected for risk reasons.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndARMConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed30 rule and ARM7/1 rule both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 'Fixed30' (fixedPreference=true) and 'ARM7/1' (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, creditScore>=720) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Most likely Fixed30 is expected since it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMConditionsAndHighDTI
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 rule and ManualReview rule both match (DTI above 50)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 'ARM7/1' (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, creditScore>=720) and 'ManualReview' (DTI>50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. Most likely ManualReview is expected.

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityAndHighLTV
testSuite.description: Fixed30 via high rate sensitivity; LTV 97 also triggers ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 'Fixed30' (rateSensitivity=high) and 'ManualReview' (LTV>95) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely ManualReview is expected.

testSuite.name: TC19_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: creditScore is null with fixedPreference=true; Fixed30 applies but ManualReview condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is missing (null); the rules do not state how a missing value is handled for the ManualReview rule. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Most likely Fixed30 is expected.

testSuite.name: TC20_AllValuesNullNoEvidence
testSuite.description: Only fixedPreference=false and rateSensitivity=low are provided; ltv, dti and creditScore are null
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv, dti and creditScore are null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled for ARM7/1 and ManualReview rules. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview. Most likely no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC21_ARMForCashOutRefinance
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 applies to refinance_cash_out purpose when all ARM conditions are met

testSuite.name: TC22_ManualReviewLowCreditAndHighLTV
testSuite.description: Credit below 640 and LTV above 95 both trigger the same ManualReview rule

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule met; expect Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference; expect Fixed30

testSuite.name: TC03_TypicalARM
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within ARM criteria; expect ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM boundaries exactly at limit (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720, DTI 50 not over 50); expect ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditScoreJustBelowARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold of 720 and is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; expect ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreAt640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIOverFiftyWithARMProfile
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 while ARM criteria are met; ManualReview expected

testSuite.name: TC09_LTVAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95; expect ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference overlaps with credit score below 640 (ManualReview rule)

testSuite.name: TC12_HighSensitivityWithDTIOver50
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity overlaps with DTI above 50 (ManualReview rule)

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceAndARMProfile
testSuite.description: Fixed preference overlaps with full ARM criteria; both rules match with different outputs
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference) and R2 (ARM7/1 via horizon, stable income, LTV, credit score) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 is assumed as rule written first.

testSuite.name: TC14_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM stability requirement; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC15_HorizonAboveSevenNoARM
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds 7 years; ARM not applicable and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; rule thresholds on null value are not defined
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how a missing credit score is handled. Possible outputs: [] (no rule) or ManualReview (treated as below 640).

testSuite.name: TC17_NullHorizon
testSuite.description: Horizon years missing while other ARM criteria are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: horizonYears is null; rules do not state how a missing horizon is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullLTVComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV left null; DMN is expected to compute it from loan amount and collateral (80%), meeting ARM criteria
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null and must be derived by DMN from loan amount and collateral; the rules do not state the derivation explicitly. Expected ARM7/1 assumes LTV = 80%; if not computed, the result would be [].

testSuite.name: TC19_RefinanceRateTermARM
testSuite.description: Refinance rate-term purpose with ARM criteria met; expect ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC20_ZeroHorizonARM
testSuite.description: Zero horizon years is within the 7-year limit; expect ARM7/1

testSuite.name: TC21_MediumSensitivityNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Medium sensitivity and no fixed preference; no rule applies with otherwise non-ARM profile

testSuite.name: TC22_AllLowCreditDTILTVViolations
testSuite.description: Credit score, DTI and LTV all violate thresholds; expect ManualReview

testSuite.name: TC23_NullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Income stability missing while other ARM criteria are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; rules require stable income for ARM7/1 but do not state how a missing value is handled. Expected [] assumes no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC24_FixedPreferenceFalseHighSensitivityAndDTI
testSuite.description: Fixed preference explicitly false but high sensitivity; Fixed30 applies, DTI within limit

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no ARM conditions met (horizon too long), no manual review trigger

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with fixedPreference false

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM71Typical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV below 80, credit score at least 720, low rate sensitivity

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM71BoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds ARM limit; no other rule applies so no product

testSuite.name: TC06_LtvJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails ARM condition, not above 95 so no manual review

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowARMThresholdVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 720 but income variable, so ARM not assigned; no manual trigger

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScore639ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScore640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no product applies

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiAboveLimitManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no product applies

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no product applies

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies and credit score below 640 triggers manual review; both rules match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ManualReview (creditScore < 640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as most likely by table order.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmAndManualDtiConflict
testSuite.description: Stable income, short horizon, LTV<=80, credit>=720 satisfy ARM; DTI 55 also triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 and rule ManualReview (DTI > 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely (risk-based override).

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedAndArmConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM criteria both satisfied
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ARM7/1 both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as most likely by table order.

testSuite.name: TC17_FixedAndManualLtvConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while LTV 97 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 and rule ManualReview (LTV > 95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as most likely by table order.

testSuite.name: TC18_ArmRefinanceRateTerm
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met for a rate-term refinance with zero-year horizon

testSuite.name: TC19_MaxCreditScoreFixed
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 with high rate sensitivity gives Fixed30 only

testSuite.name: TC20_MissingLtvAndDti
testSuite.description: ARM conditions cannot be evaluated because LTV and DTI are null; DMN is expected to compute them but inputs are missing
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv and dti are null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: [] (no rule applies) or values computed by DMN leading to ARM7/1 or ManualReview. [] chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC21_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score null; ARM and manual review conditions on credit score cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Possible outputs: [] or ARM7/1 if DMN treats missing credit score as non-blocking. [] chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC22_FixedPreferenceFalseHighRateNo
testSuite.description: Fixed preference false and rate sensitivity medium, no other criteria; no product

testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки і одночасно виконані умови ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Граничні значення для ARM: horizon 7, LTV 80, кредитний бал 720

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmTypical
testSuite.description: Типовий сценарій для ARM 7/1 з низькою чутливістю до ставки

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 років перевищує ліміт ARM, інших правил не виконано

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче порогу ARM, але не нижче 640, тому ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640 призводить до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал рівно 640 не нижче 640, тому ручний розгляд не призначається

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiAboveFifty
testSuite.description: DTI 51 понад 50 призводить до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactlyFifty
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 96 понад 95 призводить до ручного розгляду

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ручний розгляд не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC13_VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Змінний дохід не дозволяє ARM, інші умови виконані

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 85 перевищує 80 для ARM, але не перевищує 95, тому результат порожній

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: Перевага фіксованої ставки та кредитний бал нижче 640 одночасно виконують дві різні умови
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (Fixed30 через fixedPreference=true) та R3 (ManualReview через creditScore<640) одночасно виконуються; правила не визначають пріоритет, можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано Fixed30 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityAndLtvAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки та LTV понад 95 одночасно
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R1 (Fixed30 через rateSensitivity=high) та R3 (ManualReview через LTV>95) одночасно виконуються; пріоритет не визначено. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview. Обрано Fixed30 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC17_ArmAndManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: Умови ARM виконані, але DTI понад 50 активує ручний розгляд
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила R2 (ARM7/1) та R3 (ManualReview через DTI>50) одночасно виконуються; пріоритет не визначено. Можливі ARM7/1 або ManualReview. Обрано ARM7/1 як перше правило.

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingCreditScoreAndFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Відсутні креditScore та fixedPreference, решта даних вказує на ARM-умови без повної перевірки
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore відсутній (null): невідомо, чи виконана умова ARM (>=720) та чи спрацьовує R3 (<640). Можливі []; обрано [] як найімовірніше.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullLtvDtiWithHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки при відсутніх LTV та DTI, які DMN мав би обчислити
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv та dti відсутні (null); невідомо, чи перевищують вони пороги R3, тому можливий також ManualReview. Обрано Fixed30 на основі R1.

testSuite.description: Мета кредиту відсутня, але жодна умова не виконана

testSuite.name: TC21_ArmMinimalBoundaryHorizonZero
testSuite.description: Горизонт 0 років, стабільний дохід, LTV 0, кредитний бал 850

testSuite.name: TC22_MaxCreditScoreWithFixedPreferenceFalse
testSuite.description: Максимальний кредитний бал 900 без вимог Fixed30, горизонт 20 років блокує ARM

testSuite.name: TC23_ManualReviewAllThreeConditions
testSuite.description: Низький бал, високий DTI та високий LTV одночасно

      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">

          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years is above 7, so ARM7/1 does not apply; no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARM_CreditBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720, so ARM7/1 does not apply; credit is above 640 so ManualReview does not apply either.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so the application goes to ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC08_Boundaries_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640, DTI exactly 50 and LTV exactly 95 do not trigger ManualReview (strict inequalities); variable income means ARM does not apply.

testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50, so the application goes to ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_LtvAbove95

testSuite.name: TC11_Conflict_FixedAndARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true and the ARM7/1 conditions are also met. The rules do not state which rule takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference=true) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output (possible: ARM7/1).

testSuite.name: TC12_Conflict_FixedAndManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference is true while credit score is below 640, so both Fixed30 and ManualReview match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 3 (ManualReview, credit below 640) both match. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output (possible: ManualReview).

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via rateSensitivity=high) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI>50) both match. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output (possible: ManualReview).

testSuite.name: TC14_Conflict_ARMAndManualReview

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI>50) both match. The rules do not state precedence; ManualReview is the most likely output (possible: ARM7/1).

testSuite.name: TC15_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null while fixed preference is true; Rule 3 cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so the rules do not state how Rule 3 is evaluated. Fixed30 (Rule 1) is the most likely output (possible: ManualReview if missing values are treated as failing).

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Income stability is null, so the stable-income condition for ARM7/1 is not met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Expected is no product (possible: ARM7/1 if missing is treated as stable, which is unlikely).

testSuite.name: TC17_ARM_ZeroHorizonRefinance
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years, stable income, LTV 80, credit 720 on a refinance; ARM7/1 is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC18_Conflict_FixedAndManualReviewLowCredit
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with credit score 600 and DTI 60; Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via rateSensitivity=high) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via credit<640 and DTI>50) both match. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output (possible: ManualReview).

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceAndArmOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and all ARM 7/1 criteria met; R1 and R2 both match, R1 listed first
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference or high sensitivity -> Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1 criteria) both match; rules do not state precedence in words. Expected Fixed30 assuming first-listed rule wins.

testSuite.name: TC02_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference, long horizon, variable income; only R1 matches

testSuite.name: TC03_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with long horizon; only R1 matches

testSuite.name: TC04_HighSensitivityWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and credit score below 640; R1 and R3 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (high sensitivity -> Fixed30) and R3 (credit score below 640 -> ManualReview) both match; no explicit precedence stated. Expected Fixed30 assuming first-listed rule wins.

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmBoundaryValuesInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 criteria at exact boundaries: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720, stable income

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmTypical
testSuite.description: Typical ARM applicant with short horizon, stable income, good LTV and credit

testSuite.name: TC07_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7; ARM criteria not met and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_LtvJustAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds 80 for ARM; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreJustBelowArmLimit
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 below 720; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM criteria; no fixed preference or manual trigger

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReviewLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 below 640 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditScoreBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_DtiExactlyFifty
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_DtiOverFifty
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50; manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_LtvExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC16_LtvOverNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95; manual review

testSuite.name: TC17_ArmCriteriaButHighDti
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met but DTI 60 exceeds 50; R2 and R3 both match, R2 listed first
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (DTI over 50 -> ManualReview) both match; no explicit precedence stated. Expected ARM7/1 assuming first-listed rule wins.

testSuite.name: TC18_ArmCriteriaButLowLtvHighLtvRange
testSuite.description: ARM criteria met (LTV 80) and LTV not over 95; only R2 matches

testSuite.name: TC19_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; behavior of conditions with null values is not defined
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: [] (no rule matches) or ManualReview. Expected [] as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullLtvComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV null, collateral allows computing LTV of about 66.7 which satisfies ARM criteria
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null but LTV could be derived from loan amount and collateral; rules use LTV without stating whether it is computed. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 (if derived) or [] (if null). Expected ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullFixedPreferenceAndSensitivity
testSuite.description: No fixed preference or sensitivity given and ARM criteria not met; no rule applies
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability, rateSensitivity and fixedPreference are null; rules do not define null handling. Expected [] as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC22_ManualReviewCombinedFactors
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640, DTI above 50 and LTV above 95 all present; only R3 matches

testSuite.name: TC23_FixedPreferenceFalseHighLtvNoRule
testSuite.description: Fixed preference false, medium sensitivity, good credit but LTV 90 blocks ARM; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC24_FixedPreferenceWithManualCriteria
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and LTV 96 triggers manual review; R1 and R3 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixed preference -> Fixed30) and R3 (LTV over 95 -> ManualReview) both match; no explicit precedence stated. Expected Fixed30 assuming first-listed rule wins.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceAndStableArm_Ambiguous
testSuite.description: Fixed-rate preference is true and the applicant also meets all ARM 7/1 criteria. Rules R1 and R2 both match and the rules do not state which takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference=true -> Fixed30) and R2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, creditScore>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match. The rules do not state which takes precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output because it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC02_ArmSevenOne_Typical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV 70, credit 750, no fixed preference and low rate sensitivity. Only R2 matches.

testSuite.name: TC03_HighSensitivityAndLowCredit_Ambiguous
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity is high (R1) and credit score is below 640 (R3). Both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (rateSensitivity=high -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both match. The rules do not state precedence; Fixed30 is the most likely output because R1 is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC04_LowCreditScore_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 630 is below 640. Only R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC05_HighDtiOnly_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 is above 50. Only R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC06_HighLtvOnly_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 is above 95. Only R3 matches.

testSuite.name: TC07_AllBoundariesInclusive_NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit 640, LTV 95 and DTI 50 are exactly at the R3 thresholds, which are strict (<640, >50, >95), so R3 does not match. R2 fails on credit score and LTV. No rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC08_ArmBoundaryAllInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720 and DTI 50 are at the inclusive boundaries of R2 and the non-triggering boundary of R3. Only R2 matches.

testSuite.name: TC09_HorizonJustAboveLimit_NoMatch
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 is above 7, so R2 fails. No other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_VariableIncome_NoMatch
testSuite.description: Income is variable, so R2 fails. Credit, LTV and DTI are within acceptable ranges, and no preference is set. No rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_CreditJustBelowArmThreshold_NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit 719 is below 720, so R2 fails. It is not below 640, so R3 does not apply. No rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedLongHorizonVariableIncome_Fixed30

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>>95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule conditions met; assigns Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference assigns Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_AllConditionsMet
testSuite.description: Horizon 5 years, stable income, LTV 80, credit score 720 (all boundary-inclusive) assigns ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_HorizonBoundary7
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years with other ARM conditions met assigns ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC05_ARM_LTVJustAbove80_NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 breaks ARM condition; no other rule applies, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC06_ARM_HorizonJustAbove7_NoRule
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years breaks ARM condition; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_ARM_CreditBelow720_NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 breaks ARM condition and is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC08_ARM_VariableIncome_NoRule
testSuite.description: Variable income breaks ARM condition; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualReview_LowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 below 640 routes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC10_ManualReview_HighDTI
testSuite.description: DTI 55 above 50 routes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReview_HighLTV
testSuite.description: LTV 96 above 95 routes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC12_DTIBoundary50_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVBoundary95_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC14_CreditBoundary640_NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC15_CreditBoundary639_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; manual review.

testSuite.name: TC16_Conflict_FixedPrefAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and credit score 600 meet both Fixed30 and ManualReview conditions.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both apply; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Most likely Fixed30 by rule order under FIRST; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC17_Conflict_FixedPrefAndARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while all ARM conditions are also met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R2 (ARM7/1) both apply; no stated precedence. Most likely Fixed30 by rule order under FIRST; ARM7/1 is possible.

testSuite.name: TC18_Conflict_HighSensitivityAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity together with credit score 600 meets Fixed30 and ManualReview conditions.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both apply; no stated precedence. Most likely Fixed30 by rule order under FIRST; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC19_Conflict_ARMAndHighDTI
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI is 55, which also triggers ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (ManualReview via DTI>50) both apply; no stated precedence. Most likely ARM7/1 by rule order under FIRST; ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: TC20_Conflict_ARMAndHighLTV
testSuite.description: ARM horizon and income conditions met but LTV 96; ARM requires LTV <= 80, so only ManualReview applies.

testSuite.name: TC21_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null, so the credit conditions of ARM and ManualReview cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no product assigned (expected []); ManualReview is possible if null is treated as unknown-risk.

testSuite.name: TC22_MissingIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Income stability is null, so the ARM stability condition is not satisfied; no other rule applies.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Most likely no product (expected []) since 'stable' is not met.

testSuite.name: TC23_NullRateSensitivityAndFixedPref
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity and fixed preference are null; no fixed-rate condition is met and no other rule applies.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: rateSensitivity and fixedPreference are null; rules do not define handling of missing values. Most likely no product (expected []).

testSuite.name: TC24_ARM_ZeroHorizonZeroLTV
testSuite.description: Edge values: horizon 0 years and LTV 0 with high credit score assign ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC25_ManualReview_ExtremeLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 with all other fields neutral routes to manual review.

testSuite.name: fixed_preference_true_basic
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference alone triggers Fixed30; no other rule matches

testSuite.name: high_rate_sensitivity_fixed30

testSuite.name: fixed_and_arm_both_match
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM 7/1 conditions are met, so both Fixed30 and ARM7/1 apply
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 (Fixed30: fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high) and 2 (ARM7/1: horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720) both match; no precedence is stated, so Fixed30 or ARM7/1 are possible. Fixed30 is the expected output as it is listed first.

testSuite.name: arm_horizon_just_over_seven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the limit, so ARM does not apply and no manual condition holds

testSuite.name: arm_variable_income_no_product
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM 7/1; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: arm_ltv_just_over_80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the ARM limit; no other rule applies

testSuite.name: arm_credit_just_below_720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below ARM threshold and above manual threshold; no product applies

testSuite.name: manual_credit_below_640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, so manual review is required

testSuite.name: manual_dti_above_50

testSuite.name: credit_exactly_640_not_manual

testSuite.name: dti_exactly_50_not_manual

testSuite.name: ltv_exactly_95_not_manual

testSuite.name: fixed_and_manual_both_match
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true with credit score 600 triggers both Fixed30 and ManualReview

testSuite.name: arm_and_manual_dti_both_match

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 2 (ARM7/1) and 3 (ManualReview: DTI>50) both match; no precedence is stated, so ARM7/1 or ManualReview are possible. ARM7/1 is expected as it is listed first.

testSuite.name: missing_credit_score
testSuite.description: Credit score is null, so neither ARM nor manual conditions can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Empty result is assumed, but ManualReview could also be expected.

testSuite.name: missing_fixed_preference_and_sensitivity_arm
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and rate sensitivity are null; ARM conditions are all met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Fixed30 is not triggered by them, so ARM7/1 is assumed.

testSuite.name: missing_dti_arm_conditions
testSuite.description: DTI is null while all ARM conditions are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: dti is null; the manual review condition DTI>50 cannot be evaluated. ARM7/1 is assumed, but ManualReview is possible if DTI is later computed above 50.

testSuite.name: high_sensitivity_variable_income_low_credit

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules 1 (Fixed30: rateSensitivity high) and 3 (ManualReview: creditScore<640) both match; no precedence is stated, so Fixed30 or ManualReview are possible. Fixed30 is expected as it is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceTrue_Fixed30
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no overlapping conditions; only the fixed-rate rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity_Fixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference; fixed-rate rule applies, ARM conditions not met (horizon 25).

testSuite.name: TC03_HighSensitivityAndArmConditions_Overlap
testSuite.description: Rate sensitivity high and all ARM 7/1 conditions met; Fixed30 and ARM7/1 both match and the rules do not state which takes precedence.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as most likely by listing order.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 boundary values are exactly at the limit (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720); the rule text ('або менше', 'щонайменше') implies inclusion.

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Typical ARM 7/1 applicant: short horizon, stable income, low LTV, good credit, no fixed preference.

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustAboveLimit_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7; ARM rule fails and no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditBelowArmThresholdNoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold (720) but is not below 640, no DTI or LTV issues; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditBelow640_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; application goes to manual review.

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditExactly640_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiExactly50_NoProduct
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiAbove50_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 is above 50; manual review.

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvExactly95_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvAbove95_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 is above 95; manual review.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit_Overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true combined with credit score below 640; Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely (risk gating).

testSuite.name: TC15_DtiAboveWithArmConditions_Overlap
testSuite.description: DTI 55 triggers manual review while all ARM 7/1 conditions are otherwise met; ARM7/1 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC16_NullLtvComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV is null in input; the rules reference LTV, which the DMN would have to derive from loan and appraisal (75%). Result depends on whether derived LTV is used.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; rules reference LTV without stating how a missing value is handled. Expected ARM7/1 assumes LTV is derived from loan amount / appraised value (75%); if not derived, no rule matches and result would be [].

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score is missing; fixed preference is true so Fixed30 applies, but manual-review condition on credit cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how a missing value is treated in the manual-review condition. Fixed30 is expected because fixedPreference is true; if null credit triggers manual review, ManualReview would be output.

testSuite.name: TC18_VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: All other ARM conditions met except income is variable; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC19_LtvJustAboveArmLimit_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds the ARM limit of 80 but is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC20_MediumSensitivityNoFixedPreference_ArmEligible
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and false fixed preference do not trigger Fixed30; ARM conditions met.

testSuite.name: TC21_NullFixedPreferenceAndSensitivity_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and rate sensitivity are null; fixed-rate rule cannot match and no other rule applies.
