<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">
        <inputExpression id="input-5-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.ltv</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-6" label="creditScore">
        <inputExpression id="input-6-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.creditScore</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">
          <text>true</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-2">
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-2">
          <text>"high"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-3">
          <text><=7</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-4">
          <text>"stable"</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-5">
          <text><=80</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-6">
          <text>>=720</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-3-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-3-output-1">
          <text>"ARM7/1"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-4">
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-6">
          <text><640</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-4-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-4-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-5">
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-5-input-7">
          <text>>50</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-5-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-6">
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-1">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-2">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-5">
          <text>>95</text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-6-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-6-output-1">
          <text>"ManualReview"</text>
        </outputEntry>
      </rule>
    </decisionTable>
  </decision>
</definitions>

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity, fixedPreference false, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within limits

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryAllInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the ARM limit, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreBelowARMThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 for ARM and above 640 for manual review, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC07_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: TC08_LTVAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the ARM limit, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC09_LowCreditManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 routes to manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 51 routes to manual review with variable income so ARM does not apply

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 routes to manual review with variable income

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while credit score 600 triggers manual review; rules do not state precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference/high sensitivity -> Fixed30) and rule 3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both match. Precedence is not stated; possible outputs are Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as first listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while ARM conditions are also met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and rule 2 (ARM7/1) both match. Precedence is not stated; possible outputs are Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as first listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI 55 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match. Precedence is not stated; possible outputs are ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 chosen as first listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing, so rule conditions cannot be fully evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rule 2 and rule 3 depend on it and the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Empty result chosen.

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingLTVAndDTI
testSuite.description: LTV and DTI null, expected to be computed by DMN but rules do not define the computation here
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv and dti are null; the rules reference LTV and DTI but the computation from collateral and income is not specified. Empty result chosen.

testSuite.name: TC19_SchemaExamplePurchaseFixed
testSuite.description: Realistic purchase application with high rate sensitivity and fixed preference, ARM conditions not met

testSuite.name: TC20_CashOutARM
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with short horizon, stable income and strong credit

testSuite.name: TC21_MediumSensitivityARM
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity with ARM conditions met

testSuite.name: TC22_OnlyIdProvided
testSuite.description: Application with only id, all decision inputs missing
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All rule inputs are null; the rules do not state the outcome when values are missing. Empty result chosen.

testSuite.name: TC23_LowCreditBoundary640
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule matches

testSuite.name: TC24_CreditScoreBelow640Boundary
testSuite.description: Credit score 639.9 is below 640, routes to manual review

testSuite.name: ARM7_1AllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720 exactly at boundaries

testSuite.name: HorizonJustAboveSeven

testSuite.name: LtvJustAboveEighty

testSuite.name: CreditScoreJustBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720; no rule applies

testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM7/1; no rule applies

testSuite.name: ManualReviewLowCredit
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 routes to manual review

testSuite.name: ManualReviewHighDti
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 routes to manual review

testSuite.name: ManualReviewHighLtv
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 routes to manual review

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and credit below 640 both match: Fixed30 (rule 1) vs ManualReview (rule 3)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and rule 3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence, possible outputs are Fixed30 or ManualReview

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceAndArmOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM7/1 criteria both match: Fixed30 (rule 1) vs ARM7/1 (rule 2)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and rule 2 (ARM7/1 criteria met) both match; rules do not state precedence, possible outputs are Fixed30 or ARM7/1

testSuite.name: ArmAndHighDtiOverlap
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 criteria met but DTI above 50 also matches manual review rule
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 criteria met) and rule 3 (DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence, possible outputs are ARM7/1 or ManualReview

testSuite.name: DtiExactlyFiftyNotManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so ARM7/1 applies

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: LtvExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; ARM and manual review conditions cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rule 2 requires creditScore >= 720 and rule 3 requires creditScore < 640, both undetermined. Missing-value handling is not stated; most likely no rule applies (empty result), but ManualReview is also possible

testSuite.name: HighRateSensitivityOnly

testSuite.name: ARM71TypicalCase
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within limits; expects ARM7/1

testSuite.name: ARM71BoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720; all inclusive bounds met, expects ARM7/1

testSuite.name: ARM71HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7; ARM not met and no other rule applies, expects no product

testSuite.name: ARM71UnstableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM; no other rule applies, expects no product

testSuite.name: ManualReviewCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; expects ManualReview

testSuite.name: CreditScoreExactly640NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640 and ARM requires 720; expects no product

testSuite.name: ManualReviewDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 51 exceeds 50; expects ManualReview

testSuite.name: DTIExactly50NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies, expects no product

testSuite.name: ManualReviewLTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95; expects ManualReview

testSuite.name: ConflictFixedPreferenceAndManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while credit score below 640 triggers manual review; both rules match, FIRST policy picks the first listed rule
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence in words, so Fixed30 (first listed, FIRST policy) or ManualReview are possible.

testSuite.name: ConflictARMAndDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI 60 exceeds 50; both rules match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) and Rule 3 (DTI > 50 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence in words, so ARM7/1 (first listed) or ManualReview are possible.

testSuite.name: ConflictFixedAndARMConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM conditions met; both Fixed30 and ARM7/1 rules match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference or high rateSensitivity -> Fixed30) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) both match; rules do not state precedence in words, so Fixed30 (first listed) or ARM7/1 are possible.

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScoreAndRateInfo
testSuite.description: Credit score and rate preference missing (null); rule evaluation with missing values is unspecified
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore, fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are null; rules do not state how missing values are treated, so no product (empty) is the most likely outcome, but ManualReview is possible.

testSuite.name: ARM71LTVDerivedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV not provided; derived from loan 200000 and appraised value 300000 (66.67%), ARM conditions met

flaggedCases.note: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (creditScore < 640 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence in words, so Fixed30 (first listed, FIRST policy) or ManualReview are possible.

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

          <text></text>

          <text>"high"</text>

        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-3">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-4">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-5">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_Typical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within ARM criteria

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_BoundaryValues
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon 7, credit score 720, LTV 80 all inclusive

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonAboveSeven_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years fails ARM criteria; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncome_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM criteria; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowArmThreshold_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720 so ARM fails; no manual review since score is not below 640

testSuite.name: TC08_LowCreditScore_ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_HighDti_ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_HighLtv_ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvExactly95_NoProduct
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95, DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, credit 700 not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_CreditExactly640_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; DTI 50 and LTV 95 are not above thresholds; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit_Overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference (Fixed30) and credit score below 640 (ManualReview) both apply
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC14_ArmAndHighDti_Overlap
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, good credit and LTV (ARM7/1) but DTI above 50 (ManualReview)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R2 (ARM7/1) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview chosen as the conservative outcome.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndHighLtv_Overlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with LTV above 95 (both Fixed30 and ManualReview match)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_NullCreditScore_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score missing while high rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30; manual review condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled for the ManualReview condition. Fixed30 is the likely output since R1 is clearly met.

testSuite.name: TC17_AllOptionalNull_NoProduct
testSuite.description: Most attributes missing; no rule can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Many inputs are null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. No product is expected because no rule is satisfied with known values.

testSuite.name: TC18_ZeroHorizonArm
testSuite.description: Horizon 0 years with stable income and good credit and LTV qualifies for ARM7/1

testSuite.name: DtiAboveFiftyAndArmConditionsMet
testSuite.description: DTI 51 triggers manual review, but ARM 7/1 conditions are also met. Both rules match.

testSuite.name: LtvAboveNinetyFiveWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: LTV 96 triggers manual review, but explicit fixed-rate preference also matches. Both rules match.

testSuite.name: LtvExactlyNinetyFiveNoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: DtiExactlyFiftyNoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScoreWithHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score is null; Fixed30 matches via high rate sensitivity, but manual review condition on credit score cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 matches (rateSensitivity high) while the ManualReview condition on creditScore cannot be evaluated because creditScore is null. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Chosen: Fixed30.

testSuite.name: LowCreditScoreWithLowRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Credit score 600 triggers manual review; no fixed preference and low sensitivity.

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeBlocksArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM 7/1 even though other conditions are met; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: BothCreditAndDtiManualReviewConditions
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 and DTI above 50 both trigger manual review; only ManualReview applies.

flaggedCases.note: Rule Fixed30 matches (rateSensitivity high) while the ManualReview condition on creditScore cannot be evaluated because creditScore is null. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Chosen: Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, решта умов ARM не виконується (горизонт 12 років)

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки, без явної переваги фіксованої ставки

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Усі граничні значення ARM включно: горизонт 7, LTV 80, кредитний бал 720, стабільний дохід

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Типовий випадок для ARM 7/1 з низьким LTV і високим кредитним балом

testSuite.name: TC05_ARMHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Горизонт 8 років перевищує 7, ARM не призначається, жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC06_ARMIncomeNotStable
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід, ARM не призначається, жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC07_ARMCreditScoreBelow720
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче 720, ARM не призначається, жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC08_ARMLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 перевищує 80, ARM не призначається, жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640, направлення на ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreExactly640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал рівно 640 не є нижче 640, жодне правило не виконується

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, ManualReview не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiAbove50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 перевищує 50, ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ManualReview не застосовується

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 перевищує 95, ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Виконуються правило Fixed30 (явна перевага) і правило ManualReview (кредитний бал 600)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 і ManualReview застосовуються одночасно; у правилах не сказано, який має пріоритет. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30 за порядком правил.

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityAndArmConflict
testSuite.description: Виконуються правило Fixed30 (висока чутливість) і правило ARM7/1 (всі умови ARM виконані)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 і ARM7/1 одночасно виконані; у правилах не сказано, який має пріоритет. Можливі Fixed30 або ARM7/1; обрано Fixed30 за порядком правил.

testSuite.name: TC17_ArmAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Виконуються правило ARM7/1 (всі умови ARM) і правило ManualReview (DTI 60)
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила ARM7/1 і ManualReview одночасно виконані; у правилах не сказано, який має пріоритет. Можливі ARM7/1 або ManualReview; обрано ARM7/1 за порядком правил.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedAndManualLtvConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed30 через фіксовану перевагу і ManualReview через LTV 97
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 і ManualReview одночасно виконані; у правилах не сказано, який має пріоритет. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30 за порядком правил.

testSuite.name: TC19_MissingCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал відсутній (null), явна перевага фіксованої ставки
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore є null; у правилах не сказано, як поводитися з відсутнім значенням для умови ManualReview. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30 як єдине явно виконане правило.

testSuite.name: TC20_NullPreferencesArmApplies
testSuite.description: Відсутні fixedPreference і rateSensitivity (null), але всі умови ARM виконані

testSuite.name: TC21_NoRuleMatchesMidRange
testSuite.description: Середні значення без жодної умови: ні фіксована ставка, ні ARM, ні ручний розгляд

testSuite.name: FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule matching

testSuite.name: HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without fixed preference, ARM conditions not met

testSuite.name: FixedVsArmConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity while all ARM 7/1 conditions are also met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed preference or high rate sensitivity -> Fixed30) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, score>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 boundary values met exactly (horizon 7, LTV 80, score 720)

testSuite.name: ArmClearlyEligible
testSuite.description: Low-risk applicant clearly eligible for ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: HorizonAboveSevenYears
testSuite.description: Horizon exceeds 7 years so ARM 7/1 is not assigned

testSuite.name: VariableIncomeNoArm
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM 7/1 and no other rule matches

testSuite.name: LtvJustAboveArmLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds ARM limit, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: ScoreBelowArmThresholdNotManual
testSuite.description: Score 719 fails ARM threshold but is not below 640 so no manual review

testSuite.name: ScoreBelowSixFortyManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 triggering manual review

testSuite.name: ScoreExactlySixFortyNoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review (strictly below 640 required)

testSuite.name: DtiJustAboveFifty
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 triggering manual review

testSuite.name: LtvJustAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95 triggering manual review

testSuite.name: LtvExactlyNinetyFiveNoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review (strictly above 95 required)

testSuite.name: FixedVsManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference applies while credit score is below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed preference -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (score<640 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: ArmVsManualConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) and Rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ManualReview chosen as the conservative outcome.

testSuite.name: MissingLtvComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV null, expected to be derived from loan amount and collateral (approx. 33%) so ARM conditions hold
testSuite.ambiguityNote: LTV is null and must be derived by DMN from loan and collateral; the rules do not define the derivation (purchase price vs appraised value). Expected ARM7/1 assumes derived LTV is well below 80.

testSuite.name: MissingCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score missing while fixed preference is explicitly true
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is treated for the score conditions of Rule 2 and Rule 3. Fixed30 from Rule 1 is the likely outcome.

testSuite.name: ZeroCreditScoreManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score of 0 is below 640 triggering manual review

testSuite.name: CashOutRefinanceFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance with explicit fixed preference

Rule 1 (fixed preference -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (score<640 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 chosen as first-listed rule.

Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) and Rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ManualReview chosen as the conservative outcome.

creditScore is null; the rules do not state how a missing value is treated for the score conditions of Rule 2 and Rule 3. Fixed30 from Rule 1 is the likely outcome.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки, інші правила не спрацьовують (горизонт 10 років).

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки, горизонт 15 років, нестабільний дохід.

testSuite.name: TC03_ARM_TypicalCase
testSuite.description: Типовий випадок для ARM 7/1: горизонт 5 років, стабільний дохід, LTV 80, кредитний бал 730.

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM_BoundaryHorizon7AndCredit720
testSuite.description: Межеві значення для ARM 7/1: горизонт 7 років, кредитний бал 720, LTV 80.

testSuite.name: TC05_NoRule_HorizonAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Горизонт 7.5 років перевищує ліміт ARM, інші умови не виконані, продукт не призначається.

testSuite.name: TC06_NoRule_CreditBelowARMThreshold
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 719 нижче порогу 720 для ARM, але не нижче 640 для ручного розгляду.

testSuite.name: TC07_ManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 639 нижче 640, направлення на ручний розгляд.

testSuite.name: TC08_NoRule_CreditExactly640
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 640 не нижче 640, тому ручний розгляд не застосовується; ARM не виконано через бал нижче 720.

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIAbove50_WithARMConditions
testSuite.description: DTI 51 понад 50 одночасно з умовами ARM 7/1.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила ARM 7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) та ManualReview (DTI>50) виконуються одночасно; у правилах не сказано, яке правило має пріоритет. Можливі ARM7/1 або ManualReview; обрано ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC10_DTIExactly50_ARM
testSuite.description: DTI рівно 50 не перевищує 50, тому ручний розгляд не застосовується; виконуються умови ARM 7/1.

testSuite.name: TC11_ManualReview_LTVAbove95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 понад 95, ручний розгляд; ARM не виконується через LTV.

testSuite.name: TC12_NoRule_LTVExactly95
testSuite.description: LTV рівно 95 не перевищує 95, ручний розгляд не застосовується; ARM не виконується через LTV вище 80.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedAndManualReview_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Явна перевага фіксованої ставки і кредитний бал 600 (ручний розгляд).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) та ManualReview (credit<640) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedAndManualReview_DTIAbove50
testSuite.description: Висока чутливість до ставки та DTI 55 понад 50.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (rateSensitivity=high) та ManualReview (DTI>50) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedAndARM_Overlap

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (fixedPreference=true) та ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720) виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі Fixed30 або ARM7/1; обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC16_HighSensitivityAndARM_Overlap

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Правила Fixed30 (rateSensitivity=high) та ARM7/1 виконуються одночасно; пріоритет не вказано. Можливі Fixed30 або ARM7/1; обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC17_NoRule_IncomeVariable
testSuite.description: Нестабільний дохід блокує ARM 7/1, інші правила не спрацьовують.

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Відсутнє значення incomeStability; правила не визначають поведінку при null. Можливі [] або ARM7/1 при інтерпретації null як невідомої умови; обрано [].

testSuite.name: TC19_CreditScoreNull_HighSensitivity
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал відсутній, але висока чутливість до ставки запускає Fixed30.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Відсутнє creditScore; правила не визначають поведінку при null, тому умова ManualReview невизначена. Можливий результат Fixed30 або ManualReview; обрано Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC20_FixedPreferenceNull_ARMConditions
testSuite.description: fixedPreference=null не є явною перевагою; всі умови ARM 7/1 виконані.

testSuite.name: TC21_ManualReview_AllThreeConditions
testSuite.description: Кредитний бал 0, DTI 60 і LTV 98 одночасно; лише правило ручного розгляду.

testSuite.name: TC22_ARM_LTVExactly80_CreditMax

testSuite.name: TC23_LTVJustAbove80_NoARM

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true or rateSensitivity high) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, creditScore>=720) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 assumed as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmAllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM7/1 conditions met exactly at boundaries (horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720)

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmMinimalValues
testSuite.description: ARM7/1 with minimal horizon 0 and maximum credit score 900

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditScoreJustBelowArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold of 720; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_HorizonJustAboveArmThreshold
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years fails ARM horizon limit; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_VariableIncomeFailsArm
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_LtvAboveArmThreshold
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails ARM threshold; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_CreditScoreBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditScoreExactly640NoManual
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_DtiExactly50NoManual
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not over 50; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC12_DtiAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_LtvExactly95NoManual
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not over 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmAndManualOverlapDti
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50 triggers manual review
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1 conditions) and Rule 3 (DTI>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview assumed as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndLowCreditOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with credit score below 640
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 3 (creditScore<640) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 assumed as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityAndHighDti
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (rateSensitivity high) and Rule 3 (DTI>50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 assumed as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedPreferenceAndLtvAbove95
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with LTV above 95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true) and Rule 3 (LTV>95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 assumed as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC19_MediumSensitivityNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity and no fixed preference; ARM conditions not met, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC20_FixedPreferenceFalseHighSensitivity
testSuite.description: fixedPreference false but rateSensitivity high triggers Fixed30 with no other rule

testSuite.name: TC21_AllNullValues
testSuite.description: All decision inputs null; no rule condition can be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how null (missing) inputs are handled; no rule clearly matches. Expected empty result assumed.

testSuite.name: TC22_NullIncomeStabilityArmFails
testSuite.description: Null income stability prevents ARM7/1; other conditions strong
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how a missing incomeStability is handled. Rule 2 requires stable income so it is not met; expected empty result assumed.

testSuite.name: TC23_NullCreditScoreFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with null credit score; only Rule 1 can be evaluated as true
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules do not state how a missing creditScore is handled; Rule 3 (creditScore<640) cannot be confirmed. Fixed30 assumed as most likely.

  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>

      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-7">

        <outputEntry id="rule-1-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>

          <text></text>

        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-6">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <outputEntry id="rule-2-output-1">
          <text>"Fixed30"</text>

      </rule>
      <rule id="rule-3">

          <text></text>

          <text></text>

          <text><=7</text>

testSuite.name: FIXED_PREF_ONLY
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference with no other rule met; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: HIGH_RATE_SENSITIVITY_LONG_HORIZON
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with horizon too long for ARM; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: ARM_TYPICAL
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV 75, credit 730, no fixed preference; expects ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: ARM_BOUNDARY_INCLUSIVE

testSuite.name: ARM_HORIZON_JUST_ABOVE_LIMIT
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year limit; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: ARM_LTV_JUST_ABOVE_LIMIT
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the 80% limit for ARM and is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: ARM_CREDIT_BELOW_720_NO_MATCH
testSuite.description: Credit 719 is below ARM threshold and not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: ARM_VARIABLE_INCOME_NO_MATCH
testSuite.description: Variable income blocks ARM; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: MANUAL_CREDIT_BELOW_640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: CREDIT_EXACTLY_640_NO_MANUAL
testSuite.description: Credit 640 is not below 640; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: MANUAL_DTI_ABOVE_50
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 exceeds 50; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: DTI_EXACTLY_50_NO_MANUAL
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: MANUAL_LTV_ABOVE_95
testSuite.description: LTV 95.1 exceeds 95; expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: LTV_EXACTLY_95_NO_MANUAL
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule applies.

testSuite.name: OVERLAP_FIXED_AND_MANUAL_CREDIT
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and credit 600 below 640; both Fixed30 and ManualReview conditions are met.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview rule (creditScore below 640) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: OVERLAP_FIXED_AND_ARM
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while all ARM conditions are met; both rules match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (fixedPreference true) and ARM7/1 rule (all conditions met) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 expected.

testSuite.name: OVERLAP_ARM_AND_MANUAL_DTI
testSuite.description: All ARM conditions met but DTI 55 exceeds 50; ARM and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 rule (all conditions met, DTI not considered) and ManualReview rule (DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: OVERLAP_HIGH_SENSITIVITY_AND_LTV_ABOVE_95
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with LTV 97; Fixed30 and ManualReview both match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 rule (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview rule (LTV above 95) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. ManualReview expected.

testSuite.name: MISSING_CREDIT_SCORE
testSuite.description: Credit score is missing; conditions cannot be evaluated for credit thresholds and no other rule matches.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: [] (no rule applies) or ManualReview. [] expected.

testSuite.name: ALL_NULL_INPUTS
testSuite.description: Only the application id is provided; all decision inputs are missing.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are missing; rules do not state the outcome for missing values. Possible outputs: [] or ManualReview. [] expected.

testSuite.name: FIXED_MAX_CREDIT_SCORE
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score 900 with high rate sensitivity and no other triggers; expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: CASH_OUT_REFI_ARM
testSuite.description: Cash-out refinance purpose does not affect rules; ARM conditions met with LTV 80 and horizon 0.

    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">

testSuite.name: TC18_HighSensitivityAndLtvOver95

testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how a missing value is evaluated for ARM7/1 (>=720) or ManualReview (<640). Possible outputs: [] or ARM7/1 or ManualReview. Expected no product.

testSuite.ambiguityNote: fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are null; rules do not state whether a missing value counts as not meeting the Fixed30 condition. Expected ARM7/1 assuming null is not true.

testSuite.name: TC21_ZeroCreditScoreManualReview

testSuite.name: TC23_NoPreferenceNoRules

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true, horizon too long for ARM, variable income, no Manual triggers

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with no other rule matching

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, LTV and credit score within limits

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: Boundary values: horizon exactly 7, LTV exactly 80, credit score exactly 720

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years exceeds 7, ARM not applicable, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640, triggering manual review

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditExactly640NoRule
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIExactly50NoRule
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not exceed 50, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_DTIAbove50ManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50, triggering manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_LTVExactly95NoRule
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not exceed 95, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC11_LTVAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95, triggering manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_ARMLTVJustAbove80
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 fails ARM condition, other conditions met, no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC13_ARMCreditJustBelow720
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM condition, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and credit below 640 both match; rules do not state precedence between Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed preference) and Rule 3 (credit below 640) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 is assumed as the first-written rule.

testSuite.name: TC15_ARMAndFixedConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and all ARM conditions met; no stated precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixed preference) and Rule 2 (ARM conditions) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 is assumed as the first-written rule.

testSuite.name: TC16_ARMAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50; no stated precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM conditions) and Rule 3 (DTI above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 is assumed as the first-written rule.

testSuite.name: TC17_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score null; ARM condition cannot be confirmed and manual review condition cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product [] or ManualReview. Empty result assumed.

testSuite.name: TC18_LTVComputedFromCollateral
testSuite.description: LTV null, must be derived from loan and collateral; derived value depends on which collateral value is used
testSuite.ambiguityNote: LTV is null and must be computed; using purchasePrice gives 80% (ARM7/1), using appraisedValue gives 83.33% (no rule). The rules do not state which value is the base. ARM7/1 assumed.

testSuite.name: TC16_ZeroHorizonAndZeroLtv

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreWithFixedPreference

testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null, so Rule 3 (credit score below 640) cannot be evaluated. The rules do not state how a missing value is handled. Fixed30 is expected if Rule 3 is treated as not matching; ManualReview is possible if a missing score is treated as an unknown risk.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullHorizonForArm

testSuite.name: TC19_CashOutRefinanceHighSensitivity

testSuite.name: TC20_ExplicitFixedFalseArmBoundaryDti

<definitions xmlns="https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20191111/MODEL/" id="definitions" name="definitions" namespace="http://camunda.org/schema/1.0/dmn">
  <decision id="decision" name="Mortgage Product Assignment">
    <decisionTable id="decisionTable" hitPolicy="FIRST">
      <input id="input-1" label="fixedPreference">
        <inputExpression id="input-1-exp" typeRef="boolean" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.fixedPreference</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-2" label="rateSensitivity">
        <inputExpression id="input-2-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.rateSensitivity</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-3" label="horizonYears">
        <inputExpression id="input-3-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.horizonYears</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <input id="input-4" label="incomeStability">
        <inputExpression id="input-4-exp" typeRef="string" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.incomeStability</text>

      <input id="input-5" label="ltv">

      <input id="input-7" label="dti">
        <inputExpression id="input-7-exp" typeRef="number" expressionLanguage="feel">
          <text>application.dti</text>
        </inputExpression>
      </input>
      <output id="output-1" label="product" name="product" typeRef="string" />
      <rule id="rule-1">
        <inputEntry id="rule-1-input-1">

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>
        <inputEntry id="rule-2-input-7">
          <text></text>
        </inputEntry>

      <rule id="rule-3">

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVAbove95

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceVsManualReview
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with credit score below 640 matches both Fixed30 and ManualReview rules
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30 via fixedPreference=true) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via creditScore<640) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview. Fixed30 chosen as first listed row under FIRST policy.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARMVsManualReviewByDTI

testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (ManualReview via DTI>50) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview. ARM7/1 chosen as first listed row under FIRST policy.

testSuite.name: TC15_FixedPreferenceAndARMConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed preference combined with all ARM 7/1 conditions
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (Fixed30) and Rule 2 (ARM7/1) both apply; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1. Fixed30 chosen as first listed row under FIRST policy.

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is null so neither ARM nor manual review conditions can be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs: no product ([]) or ManualReview. [] chosen as most likely.

testSuite.name: TC17_NoRuleMatchesNeutralApplicant
testSuite.description: Mid-range applicant with long horizon and variable income matches no rule

testSuite.name: LtvNullComputedByDmnAsArm

testSuite.name: TC04_ARM71BoundaryInclusive

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveLimit

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreJustBelowARM

testSuite.name: TC07_LtvJustAboveARM

testSuite.name: TC08_VariableIncomeNoARM

testSuite.name: TC17_HighSensitivityWithLowCredit

testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (Fixed30) and R3 (ManualReview) both match; precedence is not stated in the rules. Fixed30 is expected by rule order.

testSuite.name: TC18_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score missing; R3 cannot be confirmed and R2 cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Possible outputs are no product or ManualReview. Empty result expected.

testSuite.name: TC19_NullPreferenceAndSensitivity

testSuite.name: TC21_ZeroCreditScoreManual

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference; ARM conditions not met (variable income, long horizon). Expects Fixed30.

testSuite.name: TC02_ARMAllBoundariesMet
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7, stable income, LTV exactly 80, score exactly 720 and no fixed preference. Expects ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC03_LowCreditScoreManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC04_DTIAboveFiftyManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 with non-stable income so ARM does not apply. Expects ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC05_LTVAboveNinetyFiveManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditScoreExactly640NoMatch
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 is not below 640; no other condition met, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC07_LTVExactly95NoMatch
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC08_DTIExactly50NoMatch
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC09_LTVJustAboveEightyNoARM
testSuite.description: LTV 80.1 exceeds the ARM limit of 80; no other rule applies.

testSuite.name: TC10_HorizonAboveSevenNoARM
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds the 7-year ARM limit; no product assigned.

testSuite.name: TC11_HighRateSensitivityFixed30
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity alone triggers Fixed30 but ARM conditions are also met (conflict with R1 and R2).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, score>=720) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC12_FixedPreferenceWithARMConditions
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true while all ARM conditions are met (conflict between Fixed30 and ARM7/1).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ARM7/1 (all ARM conditions met) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC13_HighSensitivityLowScoreConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity (Fixed30) combined with credit score below 640 (ManualReview).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview (creditScore below 640) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule; ManualReview is also possible.

testSuite.name: TC14_ARMConditionsWithDTIAbove50
testSuite.description: ARM conditions are met but DTI is above 50 (conflict between ARM7/1 and ManualReview).
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules ARM7/1 (all ARM conditions met) and ManualReview (DTI above 50) both match; the rules do not state precedence. ManualReview is expected as the more conservative outcome; ARM7/1 is also possible.

testSuite.name: TC15_NullCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score is missing, so the ARM and manual review credit conditions cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; the rules do not state how missing values are treated. ARM7/1 requires creditScore>=720 and ManualReview requires creditScore<640, so either no product or a different outcome is possible. No product is expected.

testSuite.name: TC16_AllNullDecisionInputs
testSuite.description: Key decision inputs are all null; no rule can be confirmed to match.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: All decision inputs are null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. No product is expected since no condition is confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC17_MediumSensitivityNoMatch
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity, no fixed preference, no ARM or manual conditions met.

testSuite.name: TC18_FixedPreferenceFalseHighSensitivityExplicit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference explicitly false but rate sensitivity high; Fixed30 applies on sensitivity alone with stable profile conflict.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rules Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, score>=720) both match; the rules do not state precedence. Fixed30 is expected as the first-listed rule.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityOnly
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 with no fixed preference stated

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMTypicalCase
testSuite.description: Horizon 5 years, stable income, LTV 80, credit score 720 (all boundaries included) gives ARM 7/1

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMHorizonBoundary7Years
testSuite.description: Horizon exactly 7 years is within 'seven years or less'

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditScoreJustBelowARM
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 fails ARM threshold of 720, not below 640, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_LowCreditScoreManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score below 640 sends application to manual review

testSuite.name: TC07_HighDTIManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI above 50 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC08_HighLTVManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV above 95 triggers manual review, ARM is excluded by LTV

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualBoundaryNotTriggered
testSuite.description: Credit score 640, DTI 50 and LTV 95 are boundaries that do not trigger manual review (strictly below/above)

testSuite.name: TC10_FixedAndARMOverlap
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and ARM conditions both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, score>=720) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Fixed30 is most likely expected.

testSuite.name: TC11_FixedAndManualOverlap
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and low credit score both met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and rule ManualReview (creditScore<640) both match; precedence not stated. Fixed30 is most likely expected.

testSuite.name: TC12_ARMAndManualOverlapByDTI
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule ARM7/1 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, score>=720) and ManualReview (DTI>50) both match; precedence not stated. ARM7/1 is most likely expected.

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedAndManualOverlapByLTV
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with LTV above 95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview (LTV>95) both match; precedence not stated. Fixed30 is most likely expected.

testSuite.name: TC14_MissingHorizonForARM
testSuite.description: Horizon missing so the 7-year condition cannot be confirmed
testSuite.ambiguityNote: horizonYears is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Empty result is most likely expected since ARM7/1 condition cannot be confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC15_MissingLTVNoManualTrigger
testSuite.description: LTV missing with ARM-like profile; ARM needs LTV<=80 and manual needs LTV>95
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv is null; the rules do not state how missing values are handled. Empty result is most likely expected since neither ARM7/1 nor ManualReview can be confirmed.

testSuite.name: TC16_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM stability condition

testSuite.name: TC17_LTVJustAboveARMLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 81 exceeds ARM limit of 80 and is not above 95, so no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC18_NoRuleMediumSensitivity
testSuite.description: Medium rate sensitivity, no fixed preference, strong profile but horizon 12 exceeds ARM limit

testSuite.name: TC19_ExtremeZeroValuesManual
testSuite.description: Extreme minimal values trigger manual review due to low credit score

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference applies Fixed30; no other rule matches (horizon >7, LTV<=95, DTI<=50, credit>=640).

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityWithArmProfile
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity triggers Fixed30 while the ARM 7/1 profile also matches; rule order decides.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and Rule 2 (horizon<=7, stable income, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; the rules do not state which takes precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmBoundaryInclusive
testSuite.description: All ARM 7/1 conditions at inclusive boundaries (horizon=7, LTV=80, credit=720) yield ARM7/1.

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmHorizonJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years fails the ARM condition; no other rule matches, so no product is assigned.

testSuite.name: TC05_CreditBelow640ManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640 and triggers manual review; ARM conditions fail due to credit score.

testSuite.name: TC06_CreditExactly640NoManualReview
testSuite.description: Credit score 640 is not below 640, so manual review is not triggered; no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC07_DtiAbove50ManualReviewWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: DTI 51 triggers manual review while fixed preference triggers Fixed30.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC08_DtiAbove50ManualReviewClean
testSuite.description: DTI 51 alone triggers manual review with no other rule matching.

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiExactly50NoManualReview
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 is not above 50, so manual review is not triggered; no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC10_LtvAbove95ManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV 96 exceeds 95 and triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC11_LtvExactly95NoManualReview
testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 is not above 95; no rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC12_ArmLtvJustAboveLimit
testSuite.description: LTV 81 fails the ARM condition (LTV<=80) and no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC13_ArmCreditJustBelowLimitNoManual
testSuite.description: Credit 719 fails ARM (needs >=720) but is not below 640, so no product.

testSuite.name: TC14_ArmUnstableIncomeNoProduct
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no other rule matches.

testSuite.name: TC15_ArmAndManualReviewConflict
testSuite.description: Stable income, short horizon, LTV 70 and credit 750 match ARM, but DTI 55 also triggers manual review.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 2 (ARM7/1) and Rule 3 (DTI>50 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected ARM7/1 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC16_MissingLtvAndDti
testSuite.description: LTV and DTI are null, so the ARM and manual-review conditions involving them cannot be evaluated.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: LTV and DTI are null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected no product (no rule can be confirmed), possible alternative is ManualReview.

testSuite.name: TC17_NullCreditScoreAndPreferences
testSuite.description: Credit score and preferences are null; no rule can be confirmed as matching.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore, fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are null; rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected no product; ManualReview is a possible alternative.

testSuite.name: TC18_LowRateSensitivityNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Low rate sensitivity and no fixed preference do not trigger Fixed30; ARM conditions unmet due to long horizon.

testSuite.name: TC19_MediumSensitivityFixedFalseCreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Medium sensitivity without fixed preference; credit 600 triggers manual review.

testSuite.name: TC20_FixedPreferenceWithLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference true and credit 500 both match Fixed30 and ManualReview.
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Rule 1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and Rule 3 (credit<640 -> ManualReview) both match; rules do not state precedence. Expected Fixed30 assuming table order.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed preference with long horizon and variable income; only the Fixed30 rule matches

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivity
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity without explicit fixed preference; only Fixed30 rule matches

testSuite.name: TC03_ARMBoundaryValues
testSuite.description: ARM boundaries inclusive: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit score 720, stable income

testSuite.name: TC04_ARMTypical
testSuite.description: Short horizon, stable income, low LTV, high credit score; only ARM rule matches

testSuite.name: TC05_HorizonJustAboveSeven
testSuite.description: Horizon 7.5 years exceeds 7; ARM rule fails and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_VariableIncomeNoARM
testSuite.description: Variable income fails ARM condition; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC07_LTVJustAboveEighty
testSuite.description: LTV 80.5 exceeds 80; ARM rule fails and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreJustBelowARMThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 719 is below 720; ARM rule fails and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC09_ManualBoundariesNotExceeded
testSuite.description: Credit 640, DTI 50 and LTV 95 are exact boundaries that do not trigger manual review; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC10_CreditBelow640
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 is below 640; ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: TC11_DTIAboveFifty
testSuite.description: DTI 50.1 exceeds 50; ManualReview applies and ARM fails due to horizon/income

testSuite.name: TC12_LTVAboveNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 exceeds 95; ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: TC13_LTVExactlyNinetyFive
testSuite.description: LTV 95 is not above 95; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC14_FixedPreferenceAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and credit score below 640 both match; rules do not state precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ManualReview (creditScore below 640) both match; rules do not state which takes precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC15_HighSensitivityAndDTIConflict
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and DTI above 50 both match
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (rateSensitivity high) and ManualReview (dti above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ManualReview; Fixed30 is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC16_FixedPreferenceAndARMConflict
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and all ARM conditions met simultaneously
testSuite.ambiguityNote: Fixed30 (fixedPreference true) and ARM7/1 (horizon, stable income, LTV, credit score met) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: Fixed30 or ARM7/1; Fixed30 is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC17_ARMAndManualConflict
testSuite.description: ARM conditions met but DTI above 50
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ARM7/1 (all ARM conditions met) and ManualReview (dti above 50) both match; rules do not state precedence. Possible outputs: ARM7/1 or ManualReview; ARM7/1 is listed first.

testSuite.name: TC18_MissingCreditScoreWithFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Credit score is null while fixed preference is true; Fixed30 matches but manual rule cannot be evaluated
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is missing; the ManualReview rule (credit below 640) cannot be evaluated. Rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected Fixed30; ManualReview is possible if missing values are treated as failing.

testSuite.name: TC19_MissingPreferenceFieldsARMConditionsMet
testSuite.description: Fixed preference and rate sensitivity are null; ARM conditions are met
testSuite.ambiguityNote: fixedPreference and rateSensitivity are missing, so the Fixed30 rule cannot be evaluated. Rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected ARM7/1; alternatively no rule applies if missing values are treated as not matching.

testSuite.name: TC20_MissingLTVAndDTI
testSuite.description: LTV and DTI are null, so the ManualReview thresholds cannot be checked
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv and dti are missing; the ManualReview rule (ltv above 95 or dti above 50) cannot be evaluated. Rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected no rule applies; ManualReview is possible if DMN computes LTV/DTI from other fields.

testSuite.name: TC21_ZeroCreditScore
testSuite.description: Credit score 0 is below 640; ManualReview applies

testSuite.name: TC22_MaxCreditScoreARMZeroRisk
testSuite.description: Maximum credit score, zero horizon, zero LTV and zero DTI; ARM applies

testSuite.name: TC23_LowSensitivityNoFixedPreference
testSuite.description: Low rate sensitivity, no fixed preference, horizon above 7; no rule applies

testSuite.name: TC24_FixedPreferenceWithNullPurpose
testSuite.description: Null loan purpose does not affect Fixed30 rule when fixed preference is true

testSuite.name: TC25_ARMWithNullIncomeStability
testSuite.description: Income stability is null so ARM condition cannot be confirmed; no rule clearly applies
testSuite.ambiguityNote: incomeStability is missing so the ARM rule (stable income) cannot be confirmed. Rules do not state how missing values are handled. Expected no rule applies; ARM7/1 would only result if missing values are ignored.

testSuite.name: TC01_FixedPreferenceOnly
testSuite.description: Explicit fixed-rate preference, no other rule matches

testSuite.name: TC02_HighRateSensitivityAndArmConditions
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity and all ARM conditions met at once; FIRST policy with unstated precedence
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference or rateSensitivity high -> Fixed30) and R2 (horizon<=7, stable, LTV<=80, credit>=720 -> ARM7/1) both match; rules do not state precedence in words, expected Fixed30 as first row

testSuite.name: TC03_ArmAllBoundariesInclusive
testSuite.description: ARM 7/1 with boundary values: horizon 7, LTV 80, credit 720

testSuite.name: TC04_ArmLtvJustAboveBoundary
testSuite.description: LTV slightly above 80 breaks ARM rule and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC05_ArmHorizonJustAboveBoundary
testSuite.description: Horizon 8 years breaks ARM rule and no other rule applies

testSuite.name: TC06_ArmVariableIncome
testSuite.description: Variable income prevents ARM assignment

testSuite.name: TC07_CreditScoreBelowManualThreshold
testSuite.description: Credit score 639 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC08_CreditScoreAtManualBoundary
testSuite.description: Credit score exactly 640 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC09_DtiAtBoundary50
testSuite.description: DTI exactly 50 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC10_DtiAboveThreshold
testSuite.description: DTI 50.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.description: LTV exactly 95 does not trigger manual review

testSuite.name: TC12_LtvAboveThreshold
testSuite.description: LTV 95.5 triggers manual review

testSuite.name: TC13_FixedPreferenceAndLowCredit
testSuite.description: Fixed preference with credit score 600 matches both Fixed30 and ManualReview
testSuite.ambiguityNote: R1 (fixedPreference true -> Fixed30) and R3 (creditScore<640 -> ManualReview) both match; precedence not stated, expected Fixed30 as first row

testSuite.name: TC14_LowCreditAndHighDtiAndArm
testSuite.description: Credit 800 with horizon 5, stable income, LTV 70 (ARM conditions) but DTI 60 (manual review condition)

testSuite.name: TC15_HighSensitivityLongHorizon
testSuite.description: High rate sensitivity with long horizon, no conflicts

testSuite.name: TC16_ArmMinimalValues
testSuite.description: Zero horizon, perfect credit and LTV zero, stable income

testSuite.name: TC17_CreditScoreNullFixedFalse
testSuite.description: Credit score missing, no other rule matches
testSuite.ambiguityNote: creditScore is null; rules do not state how missing values are handled for the credit score condition (R3 and R2); expected no product

testSuite.name: TC18_DtiAndLtvNullFixedPreference
testSuite.description: DTI and LTV null with fixed preference true
testSuite.ambiguityNote: ltv and dti are null; rules do not say whether DMN must compute them, and R3 conditions on them are undetermined; expected Fixed30 from R1

testSuite.name: TC19_MediumSensitivityNoMatch
testSuite.description: Medium sensitivity, long horizon, average profile, no rule applies
